english.title: Distribute / cause to be distributed a prohibited advertisement of a low-welfare animal activity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in the course of a business,

(A)_[distributed in England an advertisement that was published in England and was]_
(B)_[caused an advertisement that was published in England to be distributed in England, it being]_

a prohibited advertisement in that it had the purpose or effect of promoting the observation of, or participation in, an activity which involved an animal, taking place outside the United Kingdom and was of a description specified by activity regulations made by the Secretary of State, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 2(4) and 3(1) of the Animals (Low-Welfare Activities Abroad) Act 2023.

english.notes:
(i) A person does not commit this offence if the advertisement is contained in a publication (other than an in-flight magazine) which is printed outside a relevant part of the United Kingdom, and whose principal market is not, or does not include, a relevant part of the United Kingdom or any part of one (section 2(5)).
(ii) A person does not commit this offence if the distribution is by means of electronic transmission, and the person did not carry on business in a relevant part of the United Kingdom at the time of the distribution (section 2(6)).
(iii) A person does not commit this offence by selling a publication to a member of the public (section 2(4)).
(iv) It is a defence for a person charged with this offence in relation to the printing or distribution of an advertisement in a relevant part of the United Kingdom to prove that the person did not know, and had no reason to suspect, that the advertisement would be published in that part (section 2(8)).
(v) See section 3(6) of the Act for offences committed by bodies corporate.
